points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Output packages and report were structurally accepted by prior examiner; M2 success statuses contradict their force evidence, so correct file layout is not valid convergence.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior examiner evidence reports structural pass; it cannot determine physical convergence or identify the false success labels. No new evaluator CFD run.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 inviscid periodic and four-step M2 laminar converged labels are unsupported by their submitted force figures. Re200 reaches t300 but report discloses no resolved vortex street.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M2 inviscid irregular lift and laminar Cd1.913 still falling; Re200 weak non-street signal. Remaining steady cases have distinct force-window evidence in case notes; np4 M2 divergence lacks matched binary proof.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: 30-page compiled report includes per-case fields and force/residual figures. Re200 full-history force scale hides both late components; several steady plots compress startup-to-tail detail.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report documents first-order M2 controls and absent Re200 street, but calls physically unsettled M2 outputs successful. Re200 late force plot is unreadable; report text supplies numeric and drifting frequency estimates.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report figure manifest and committed figure assets exist; original workspace selected CSVs were not found at corresponding checkpoint paths and revision stamp is cached. No unverified binary-source link assumed.
